analysis.summary: For FY 2024-25, Vikram Thermo (India) Limited recorded a revenue from continuing operations of Rs. 12,623.06 lakhs compared to Rs. 10,127.26 lakhs in FY 2023-24. Profit After Tax stood at Rs. 809.85 lakhs, down from Rs.

guidance.claim: The company aims to drive growth by investing in R&D, adopting emerging technologies, and enhancing its product portfolio.
guidance.quote: As we move forward, the Company remains steadfast in its commitment to consistent investment in R&D, the adoption of emerging technologies, and the continuous enhancement of its product portfolio to meet the dynamic demands of the market.

guidance.claim: As the company enters fiscal 2024, it plans to enter new markets with favorable competition and focus on complex and new products.
guidance.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's PAN-India presence and expanding global footprint contributed to its growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Our extensive PAN-India presence, along with a steadily expanding global footprint, has significantly contributed to the Company's growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Vikram Thermo is focused on driving profitable revenue growth via high-margin, research-driven products for domestic and international markets.
demand_outlook.quote: With a focus on building a sustainable and scalable business model, the Company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products tailored to the specific needs of customers in both domestic and international markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The company achieved its highest total income and profits in its history during FY 2023.
demand_outlook.quote: You will be happy to note that during FY 2023, your company achieved the highest total income and profits in its history.

capex_expansion.claim: The Scheme of Demerger for the Aromatic Chemicals business was approved by the NCLT on April 26, 2024.
capex_expansion.quote: Scheme of Demerger for the Company's Aromatic Chemicals (Diphenyl Oxide) business was approved by the Hon'ble NCLT, Ahmedabad, by its order dated April 26, 2024.

capex_expansion.claim: The company approved a scheme of arrangement and demerger to transfer its Aromatic Chemical Business into Vikram Aroma Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: The company has announced through its Board Meeting held on17th September, 2022 the Approval of the Scheme of Arrangement and demerger whereby Aromatic Chemical Business (hereinafter referred to as 'Demerged Business' or Unit II) of M/s Vikram Thermo (India) Limited will be demerged into M/s Vikram Aroma Limited.

margins_costs.claim: Vikram Thermo recorded revenue of Rs. 12,623.06 lakhs from continuing operations and Rs. 451.98 lakhs from discontinuing operations, with PAT of Rs. 809.85 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: The Company recorded a revenue of Rs.12,623.06 lakhs from continuing operation and Rs.451.98 lakhs from discontinuing operation and a Profit After Tax (PAT) of Rs.809.85 lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: The decrease in Profit After Tax was primarily due to the demerger of a business unit.
margins_costs.quote: While the PAT reflects a decrease primarily due to the demerger of a business unit, the overall performance of the continuing operations has shown notable improvement.

margins_costs.claim: Total income from continuing operations increased to Rs. 12,623.06 lakhs in FY25 from Rs. 10,127.26 lakhs in FY24.
margins_costs.quote: Total Income from continuing operation increased to Rs. 12623.06 Lakhs in comparison to Rs. 10127.26 Lakhs of Previous Financial Year 2023-24.

margins_costs.claim: Operating income rose to Rs. 112.89 crores in FY 2023, while profit after tax expanded to Rs. 16.91 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Our operating income grew to Rs. 112.89 crores, a growth of 20.95% as compared to the previous FY 2022, Our profits after tax increased by 94.59% from Rs. 8.69 crores, in FY 2022 to Rs. 16.91 crores in FY 2023.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a 10% dividend of Rs. 1 per share on the paid-up equity capital for FY25.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 10% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 1 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The dividend payment will result in a total cash outflow of Rs. 3,13,57,850.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs. 3,13,57,850/- (Previous Year Rs. 2,35,18,388/-).

capital_allocation.claim: No profit was transferred to reserves for FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has not transferred any amount to the reserves from the profit for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The demerger allows both resulting companies to isolate business risks, raise independent capital, and unlock future value.
capital_allocation.quote: The demerger would also help each company to isolate the risks between their respective businesses, raise capital based on their individual requirements and unlock value in future.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 7.5% on equity shares.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 7.5% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 0.75 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The company transferred Rs. 30,00,000 to General Reserves during the financial year 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has transferred Rs. 30,00,000/- to General Reserves during the financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's dividend payout will involve a total cash outflow of Rs. 1,56,78,925.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs.1,56,78,925/- (Previous Year Rs.94,07,355/-).

capital_allocation.claim: The company allotted 25,086,280 bonus equity shares of Rs. 10 each in May 2022.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has made allotment of 25086280 bonus shares of Rs.10 each in the Board Meeting held on 14th May, 2022.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company continuously identifies risks across business strategy, continuity, operations, statutory compliance, cyber security, and internal controls.
risks_headwinds.quote: Risks are being continuously identified in relation to business strategy, business continuity/contingency plans, operations and transactions, statutory / legal compliance, financial reporting, information technology system, cyber security and overall internal control framework.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced operational challenges stemming from global uncertainties and the aftershocks of the COVID-19 pandemic.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the global uncertainties and unprecedented challenges that came in our way through the aftershocks of covid-19 pandemic, we remained resilient and steadfast in our commitment to deliver value to all our stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to consistent investment in R&D, adopting emerging technologies, and enhancing its product portfolio.
management_commitments.quote: As we move forward, the Company remains steadfast in its commitment to consistent investment in R&D, the adoption of emerging technologies, and the continuous enhancement of its product portfolio to meet the dynamic demands of the market.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue its transformation by venturing into new markets and developing new, complex products in fiscal 2024.
management_commitments.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
